condition_tests.literal_condition: A defined governance or protective control is applicable and validly becomes operative.
condition_tests.assessment: No specific activated protective control is identified by the loss report.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The control has an identifiable protective purpose requiring a material effect such as prevention, blocking, containment, interruption, redirection, limitation, escalation, mitigation, or another protection-compatible outcome.
condition_tests.assessment: No control-specific protective purpose can be tested from the amount/date.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The actual control effect materially falls short of that required protective purpose, allowing the governed hazard to be delivered, continue, escape containment, or remain insufficiently mitigated.
condition_tests.assessment: Loss alone does not locate activation or effectiveness.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The shortfall is material in the evidenced hazard and protection context; where vulnerability, developmental status, capacity limitation, temporary or situational consent impairment, acute distress, cognitive asymmetry, or another heightened protection condition is relied on, that condition must itself be supported rather than presumed.
condition_tests.assessment: Financial impact is material, but cannot replace the missing control evidence.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): The applicable control does not become operative when a valid activation condition occurs; assess Required Control Activation.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The control becomes operative even though its valid activation or applicability conditions are not satisfied; assess Control Activation Validity.

Not aligned exclusion: The control becomes operative with a sufficient effect but its operative state is later lost, weakened, reset, or transformed before reaching the governed point; assess Control-State Preservation.

Class scope exclusion (all results): An operative governance signal fails to reach any capable endpoint or execution surface; assess the applicable governance-control reach class rather than treating non-delivery as inadequate control effect.

independent_materiality.determination: material reported actual containment, notification and review
independent_materiality.governance_proposition: Disabling the faulty evaluation stops its live hazard pathway, distinct from promised isolation improvements.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An applicable validly activated protective control faces its governed hazard.
condition_tests.assessment: A live misconfigured test pathway is identified and disablement engaged.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The control produces a timely effect sufficient for its protective purpose and evidenced context, including any justified heightened protection.
condition_tests.assessment: Disabling the affected evaluation is reported to contain that pathway.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Observed intervention and hazard outcome demonstrate the required containment or mitigation rather than activation alone.
condition_tests.assessment: Evaluator reports issue resolved and no active scenario issue; this supports a bounded containment result, not global systems assurance.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): The applicable control does not become operative when a valid activation condition occurs; assess Required Control Activation.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The control becomes operative even though its valid activation or applicability conditions are not satisfied; assess Control Activation Validity.

Not aligned exclusion: The control becomes operative with a sufficient effect but its operative state is later lost, weakened, reset, or transformed before reaching the governed point; assess Control-State Preservation.

Class scope exclusion (all results): An operative governance signal fails to reach any capable endpoint or execution surface; assess the applicable governance-control reach class rather than treating non-delivery as inadequate control effect.
Not aligned exclusion: The control produces the protective effect required by its defined purpose and the remaining harm arises through an independent downstream mechanism.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The dispute is solely that policy should have required a stronger safeguard, without evidence of an applicable operational control or protective-effect obligation in the material context.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Disability, neurodivergence, diagnosis, age-associated stereotype, or another personal characteristic is used by itself to presume incapacity, vulnerability, or diminished agency.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Later containment does not erase the earlier out-of-scope intrusion; promised future improvements alone would not suffice.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No evidence that this contained route continued after shutdown is supplied.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A governance signal requires a response or disposition.
condition_tests.assessment: The evaluator’s incident notification requires capable recipient response.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Accountable ownership, a capable destination, status and escalation remain established until the required effect or authorised disposition occurs.
condition_tests.assessment: Provider receipt and ensuing review are reported; affected-party notification is asserted but its response not independently traced.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Delivery, ownership and response evidence traces the signal through to its bounded disposition.
condition_tests.assessment: The Meta notification-to-review route has an observed bounded disposition; affected-party recovery remains separate.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The signal reaches a capable destination and is deliberately rejected through an authorised decision.
Class scope exclusion (all results): No governance signal was produced because the control failed to activate.
Not aligned exclusion: The signal has operational effect but its delivery is not recorded for audit.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: A capable destination actually reviewed records; do not require public logs as a categorical prerequisite.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No stalled Meta notification is evidenced.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Reconsider bounded positive control-effect and governance-signal delivery mappings. Both sources describe actual actions, beyond a roadmap. Limit success to the affected scenario shutdown and notification-to-Meta review; do not infer complete remediation, affected-party recovery or independent global review.
